mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS promptTokens, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS completionTokens, COUNT(*) AS callCount, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatencyMs FROM t_ai_usage_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT model, scene, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS promptTokens, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS completionTokens, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS totalTokens, COUNT(*) AS callCount FROM t_ai_usage_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY model, scene ORDER BY totalTokens DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS totalTokens, COUNT(*) AS callCount, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatencyMs FROM t_ai_usage_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
